ITEM 1 | Pale yellow scrambled eggs, soft and moist with a fluffy, curd-like texture, clumped into an irregular mound about 9 cm wide and 8 cm tall-ish spread across the upper-center of the plate, with small loose crumbs at the left edge; slight glossy sheen, no visible browning | 110
ITEM 2 | Two strips of cooked bacon lying side by side across the lower-right of the plate, reddish-brown with darker caramelized edges and some pale fat streaks, slightly glossy and firm, each strip about 14 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, overlapping at the center | 30
